llm_raw_reply: SBI Landmark Reward SELECT looks like the biggest saver at about ₹38 k a year, but most of that comes from a milestone benefit that’s probably over‑valued, so the real cash back could be lower. The ixigo AU Credit Card is a close second with about ₹30 k saved and no joining or annual fee, though it also leans heavily on a milestone that may not be as valuable as shown. Either could work, but the ixigo AU gives you the same vibe without any fee.
